correction.retired_assumption: A developer-console manual replay can be requested as the P0 same-event witness.
correction.replacement: Use Feishu's documented automatic retry after a controlled, one-event acknowledgement failure in the actual receive path.

official_feishu_contract.automatic_retry: A failed or late acknowledgement causes automatic retry; no generic manual replay control was found in the reviewed official documentation.
official_feishu_contract.event_log_signal: retry_cnt greater than one identifies a retry.
